subject.title: refactor: remove expired plugin compatibility surfaces

question: Should the July compatibility sweep wait for each registry `removeAfter` date, or should the affected release be scheduled after the latest removed public contract expires?
rationale: The branch’s stated July 21 release timing precedes several public removal windows, so a maintainer must choose the release/removal boundary rather than silently shortening a documented external contract.

options.title: Honor each recorded window
options.body: Retain every public compatibility surface until its individual `removeAfter` date and split or defer the early release removals.

options.title: Move the release boundary
options.body: Schedule the release containing these removals after the latest applicable public removal date, with the provider accessor regression repaired first.

recommendation.title: Honor each recorded window
recommendation.body: Retain every public compatibility surface until its individual `removeAfter` date and split or defer the early release removals.

likelyOwner.reason: The commit series, assignment, and stated registry sweep place this contributor closest to the release/removal boundary decision.
